title: Loveless
headline: Their label thought this album would take five days. It took nineteen studios.
caption:
Loveless came out 35 years ago today, on 4 November 1991, after more than two and a half years of sessions.

One detail that didn't fit on the slides: when it was finally time for vocals, Kevin Shields and Bilinda Butcher hung curtains over the window between the control room and the vocal booth. Engineer Guy Fixsen recalled: "We weren't allowed to listen while either of them were doing a vocal. You'd have to watch the meters on the tape machine to see if anyone was singing."

The follow-up, m b v, finally arrived in 2013.

Which Loveless track would you play for someone hearing it for the first time?
